# SQLite

`sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` are SQLite 3.54.1, unmodified, from the official amalgamation
`sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip` (<https://www.sqlite.org/download.html>), whose SHA3-256 is
`92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`. SQLite is in the public domain
(<https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html>).

To update: download the new amalgamation, check its SHA3-256 against the download page, replace these two files, and
change the version, the zip name and the hash above.
